Name: Nyapu style Arumi the Actress
Author: DizzyMermaid
Description:
[b]Description[/b]
I'm apparently on a roll with Nyapu portrait replacements for NPCs that don't yet have them. Here's the third! (And also attempt number three to upload it...) Arumi and her daughter Himeko are both included. I've also made veeeery minor changes to Himeko's sprites to make her look the teensiest bit younger while still feeling like she's tall for her age. (Arumi's sprites I would never touch because they're actual perfection.)

[b]Installation instructions[/b]
This is not a Content Patcher mod! It will replace Arumi and Himeko's portraits as well as Himeko's sprite sheet.

Simply download the mod, extract the files, and pop it into your [CP] Arumi Asaki - Release in your mods folder - you will be prompted to replace 5 files. They will be put in the Custom folder as provided by the original mod author, so in the config menu when you're loading the mod, select "Custom" for the Portraits folder. Et voila!

[b]Requirements[/b]
The original mod, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/44286]Arumi the Actress[/url].

[b]Shout outs[/b]
Thanks to NassiLove, the creator of Arumi the Actress, for letting me upload my version!
And of course the biggest credit to Nyapu for their fantastic art and permission to use their assets.
